data.name: T.R.K : BORDER LINE
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

TRK: BORDERLINE is a first-person shooter (FPS) military tactical experience that places players on the frontlines of modern conflict zones. Set along volatile border regions filled with tension, combat, and irreversible decisions, every moment demands precision, awareness, and the will to survive.

With realistic combat mechanics, highly detailed weapons, and meticulously crafted environments, TRK delivers an intense and immersive warfare experience filled with constant pressure and high-stakes encounters.

Step into modern battlefields where danger is everywhere and every decision can mean survival or defeat. Experience fast, responsive, and realistic combat designed to deliver intensity in every engagement.

Campaign

The Campaign mode takes players through a variety of military operations across carefully designed warzones. Engage in both ground and aerial combat while operating authentic military equipment, including tanks and fighter jets. Complete critical missions, navigate hostile environments, and fight to survive on the battlefield.

Online Multiplayer

Online Multiplayer is designed to be fast-paced, intense, and highly rewarding. Matches are structured to deliver quick, satisfying combat experiences while maintaining tactical depth. Participate in popular modes such as Team Deathmatch and Conquest, coordinate with your team, and secure strategic objectives to achieve victory.

Maps and Weapons

The game features over 15 unique maps, each offering distinct environments and tactical opportunities. Players can freely choose their weapons through the Free Weapon system, allowing full flexibility to match individual playstyles and combat preferences.

Experience immersive first-person combat focused on realism and tactical engagement. Enter unstable conflict zones where every movement, every shot, and every decision matters.

Engage enemies across diverse environments including forests, military bases, and strategic strongholds. Use skill, precision, and tactical awareness to complete objectives and survive.

Every battle is filled with tension, gunfire, explosions, and the atmosphere of modern warfare—creating an experience that truly places you on the battlefield.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 super
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires 64-bit processor and operating system Integrated graphics cards not supported Controller support recommended for optimal experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 65 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible with surround sound support
  • Additional Notes: SSD installation recommended for faster loading times 1080p gaming at 60fps with High settings

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent depictions of realistic military combat, including the use of firearms, explosions, and combat-related violence. Players will engage enemy combatants using a variety of modern weapons, vehicles such as tanks and fighter jets, and tactical equipment.

Combat scenarios may include gunfire, battlefield injuries, and visual effects associated with warfare. The game focuses on military operations in conflict zones and presents intense combat situations in a realistic setting.

There is no sexual content, nudity, or graphic torture. The mature content is limited to realistic depictions of combat and warfare consistent with modern military-themed games.
